title: Coast Guard coordinates rescue of two British mariners 598 miles off Bermuda
description: A small boatcrew from the tanker vessel Magellan Spirit rescues two people off of a disabled and adrift 39-foot sailing vessel 580 miles off the coast of Bermuda, May 1, 2020. The Magellan Spirit was registered with the Automated Mutual-Assistance Vessel Rescue System, which enables good Samaritan vessels to be called upon by rescue coordination centers to assist vessels in their area that need help. (U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Coast Guard Air Station Elizabeth City)
